test_title: PYST 23: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster pair that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) LP - JK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cdacbc3e7a5b4f070baf742b82f187da594f88ede4c8d1c31168ab24a6d80bd.png] 

Option 2) JN - HL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e188381b936a105df01c64de62de5ed1c7cff79b298f9c0d989903798f4a4ad.png] 

Option 3) OS - MQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d44b7b5910726e9e60340e1a6f0a905f4b55a84a883aa83707e13c92793124de.png] 

Option 4) NR - LP

​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/152b98e545d4edb2c0d30235c7693406c0145e3c9be0aecb3ed9c7589e959f5a.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'LP - JK' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
